{{Quote|All right. Take these codes to a man named Gnurr Fenkel. He knows to expect you, so if he doesn't say, "You looking for Corellian Double-Brandy?" when he sees you, blast him and bring the codes back to me.|Luthin Dlunar to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Gnurr Fenkel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateThug.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Gnurr Fenkel]]
Gnurr Fenkel was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
